description_text:
Game ready low-poly Kitchen Utensils models with PBR textures for game engines/renderers.
This product is intended for game/real time/background use. This model is not intended for subdivision. Renders done in Marmoset Toolbag 3. Default render in Blender will NOT look like the preview images. The Marmoset Toolbag scene is included.
The textures in the embedded Marmoset preview are somewhat compressed. The textures you get when you purchase this product have better quality.
||SPECS||

  - Geometry is triangulated to ensure best shading.

  - Model unwrapped manually to make most efficient use of the UV space.

  - All materials and objects named appropriately.

  - Scaled to approximate real world size.

  - Tested in Marmoset Toolbag 3(see renders).

  - Tested in Unreal Engine 4.

  - Tested in Unity Engine.

  - Unity and Unreal Engine 4 projects are included.

  - No special plugins needed.

  - .dae, .abc, .stl, .obj and .fbx versions exported from Blender 2.83.

|| Textures ||
4096x4096 textures:

  - General PBR Metallic/Roughness  textures: BaseColor, Metallic, Roughness, Normal(DirectX), Normal(OpenGL), AO.

  - Unity Textures: Albedo, MetallicSmoothness, Normal(OpenGL), AO.

  - Unreal Engine 4 textures: BaseColor, OcclusionRoughnessMetallic, Normal(DirectX).

  - PBR Specular/Glossiness textures: Diffuse, Specular, Glossiness, Normal(DirectX), Normal(OpenGL), AO.

All textures in png format. Also included clean variant of textures without damage.  Substance Painter source files also available in the extra downloads so that you can easily alter the textures as you wish with Substance Painter.

description_text:
A simple ceramic coffee mug created with Blender 2.73 and rendered in Cycles. In this file are three mugs in three different colors included. Yellow, red and blue.
YOU WANT A LOW POLY GAME READY VERSION OF THIS MODEL? JUST LET ME KNOW!
|| GEOMETRY ||
Clean geometry, quads only. No ngons!
|| TEXTURES ||
This model uses only one noise texture as a bumpmap for a slight displacement. The texture is generated with Cycles nodes itself.
|| MATERIALS ||
The coffee mug has 3 materials applied. A white ceramics on the inside, a colored ceramics on the outside and a natural rough ceramics on the bottom. All materials are created with nodes for Cycles Render. You can easily change the color of the mug by editing only one color value in the material node.
|| COMPOSITING ||
Compositing setup to render the model isolated from the environment with alpha values as background included.
|| RENDERS ||
  - renders created in Cycles Render at 1.000 samples using subsurf modifier level 2 - wireframe renders are showing the mesh without subsurf modifier
|| SCALE ||
The model is in real world size and scale.
X = 0,116m (Blender units) Y = 0,084m (Blender units) Z = 0,088m (Blender units)
|| EXPORTED FILES ||
This model was created with Blender. Only the blend file includes materials, textures and modifiers. All other formats have been exported and including only the mesh!
|| END ||

  - fbx - contains simplified materials

description_text:
Model of an old, worn and somewhat rusty enameled plate with 4K PBR-textures built to real-world scale (metric system).
The plate is a classic design inspired by the old enameled products of the Kockums brand, especially the yellow series with green edges that were produced from the 1930s to the 1970s.
The model was created using Blender and Substance Painter. Preview images were rendered with Iray.
Polygon Count
1154 vertices
1184 faces
2304 triangles  
File Formats
Autodesk FBX (.fbx)
OBJ (.obj)
Collada (.dae)
Blender v2.79 (.blend)  
Materials & Textures
The model is UV-mapped and has a single material with a set of physics based textures (PBR MetalRough workflow).  
The textures are not baked into the model, but are saved as png-files with a resolution of 2048 x 2048 pixels (8 bits) in the zip-file PBR textures:  
Rusty mug_Enameled metal_BaseColor.png
Rusty mug_Enameled metal_Height.png
Rusty mug_Enameled metal_Metallic.png

description_text:
Game ready low-poly Electric Kettle model in 2 colors with PBR textures for game engines/renderers.
This product is intended for game/real time/background use. This model is not intended for subdivision. Renders done in Marmoset Toolbag 3. Default render in Blender will NOT look like the preview images. The Marmoset Toolbag scene is included.
The textures in the embedded Marmoset preview are somewhat compressed. The textures you get when you purchase this product have better quality.
||SPECS||

  - Geometry is triangulated to ensure best shading.

  - Model unwrapped manually to make most efficient use of the UV space.

  - All materials and objects named appropriately.

  - Scaled to approximate real world size.

  - Tested in Marmoset Toolbag 3(see renders).

  - Tested in Unreal Engine 4.

  - Tested in Unity Engine.

  - Unity and Unreal Engine 4 projects included.

  - No special plugins needed.

  - .dae, .abc, .stl, .obj and .fbx versions exported from Blender 2.82.

|| Textures ||
4096x4096 textures

  - General PBR Metallic/Roughness  textures: BaseColor, Metallic, Roughness, Normal(DirectX), Normal(OpenGL), AO.

  - Unity Textures: Albedo, MetallicSmoothness, Normal(OpenGL), AO.

  - Unreal Engine 4 textures: BaseColor, OcclusionRoughnessMetallic, Normal(DirectX).

  - PBR Specular/Glossiness textures: Diffuse, Specular, Glossiness, Normal(DirectX), Normal(OpenGL), AO.

All textures in png format. Substance Painter source files also available in the extra downloads so that you can easily alter the textures as you wish with Substance Painter.

description_text:
Set of 7 different frying pans for kitchen archiviz. The set contains:

  - oldschool pan with edgy handle

  - modern all-pupose pan

  - poached eggs pan with 3 dimples

  - low edge pan for frying crepes and pancakes

  - a deep wok for asian cuisine

  - a rounded square shaped grill pan with several fins

  - a saucepan (pot) with metal cover

These models dont need any texture files, as all the shaders are procedural. You can adjust the subdivision level if you don't need a high poly model.

description_text:
3D Model Set of:

  - 
a 7 Piece Set of Cutlery consisting of

  -  a little, normal and big Fork (5762 | 14489 | 11682)

  -  a little and normal butter-knife (3810 | 5376)

  - a little and normal Spoon (3810 | 5367)

This Model was tested and made to work with Blenders Cycles Engine all previews and examples are given from there.
Thank You for reading this and considering to use my 3D Model :)

description_text:
Chest freezer. This asset is game ready, uses as few polygons and vertices where possible, omitting polygons when not seen e.g underneath and the back.
Model has been built to real world scale.

  - 
File Formats: unitypackage, FBX, OBJ

  - 
Animation: Lid opens and shuts

  - 
Asset ID: ls-pr-chest-freezer-a

  - 
Polygons: 26

  - 
Vertices: 28

  - 
UV Mapping: Yes. Has a single UV Map Channel.

  - 
Unwrapped UVS: Non-overlapping

  - Low Poly(game-ready)

  - 
Textures: Albedo, Ambient Occlusion, Metallic/Glossiness/Reflection, Normal 

  - 
Max Texture Size Included: 2048 x 2048 @ 5.12 px/cm texel density

  - 
Optimal Texture Size (Ideal for performance): 1024 x 1024 @ 2.56 px/cm texel density. See the Default tab on each Unity texture for optimal sizes.

Unity: Exported as a Unity Package, with URP. This can easily be converted to HDRP with Unity via Edit > Render Pipeline > HD Render Pipeline > Upgrade Project Materials. An animation controller with parameters has already been setup for your convenience, along with the Animation clips if applicable. Generate Lightmaps UV’s is on and 1 Unity unit = 1 metre.
Other game engines / applications: The FBX files and textures can easily be used with the Unreal Engine or 3D applications which support FBX. The models use few materials and textures and should be easy to create your own materials and assign the textures. Animation frames are also included if applicable.

description_text:
A kitchen scale prop. Blue in colour, circular, 18.5cm in diameter, and 1.6cm thick.
Geometry:

  - Tris and quads only, not subdividable.

  - Smooth shading with some custom edge normals for sharper edges.

  - Modelled to real-world scale, units: metres

  - Object is composed of two separate watertight meshes - the base and the glass surface. A small air gap is left between both meshes to allow for more realistic refraction and prevent potential z-fighting. 

Texturing:

  - PBR textures, Color, normal, specular, roughness, transparency. 

  - 2048*2048 resolution (2K)

  - png format

  - Entirely UV mapped with no overlap. 

Created in Blender. .blend file has textures packed (embedded in the file).

in the scene without correcting the external original file, that is, the same original model may have each own unique color solution in each of your
scenes.Absolute advantage of such approach is the small size of the work file which gives an opportunity to use regular equipment without using expensive
professional machines.If for some reasons you are not a fan of using external links in your projects – don’t get upset. Our product is completed with the scene where all the
models are presented in the original mesh.

description_text:
Purple Sand Clay (also known as Yixing clay 宜興紫砂) is a type of clay produced in the region of Yixing in China, used in Chinese pottery since the Song dynasty (960–1279 AD). Since 17th century, Yixing wares had been exported to Europe. The finished stoneware, which is used for teaware and other small items, is usually red or brown in colour.  Yixing clay are the most welcomed and expensive materials for making teaware due to its great properties for bring out the fragrance and taste of tea. So Teawares made of Yixing clay have been as famous as porcelain teawares in China.
The style of this teapot refers to the antique teapot made in Ming Dynasty (1513AD). 96mm(h) x 118mm(w).

description_text:
Baseline LCD monitor/screen. Lighting is setup to render out real-life looking renders as seen in preview pictures.
Fully editable if you so wish. The monitor was made with the box-modeling method, and NO BOOLEANS were used, which means the geometries are nice and clean.
The main file contains the monitor, and the stand part at the bottom. You can decide whether you want to have the monitor with or without the stand. Meshsmooth is applied in the scene but can be turned off.
Low resolution models in the export.rar file, with many different formats included. No Smoothing applied in these models.
You'll see in one of the previews there is a wallpaper on the screen. This is one of my own photos taken by myself. It is included for you to use in the supporting items.
The poly/vert count is WITHOUT meshsmooth applied, but the poly/vert count in the main scene (with Meshsmooth applied) is 5480/5479

Geometry

  - 972 Verts

  - 2735 Tris

If the normals don't look correct try inverting the green channel of the normal map.

Added textures for HDRP.Known issue for UE4: Pivot point for the door doesn't work properly and doors have to be moved inside blender. For Unity following problem does not occur. 
Vintage fridge to make your game scene cooler (and gross)  - this one is clearly beaten down -  fits very well for horror or postapo scene - textures for Unity 5 and Unreal Engine 4
Real world measurements. Units set to meters.

4K Textures in 4 different formats.PBR Metallic Roughness Unity 5Unity HDRPUnreal Engine 4
Please note that blend., fbx., obj., stl. files contains only clear mesh model without textures. Textures are stored in a separate ZIP archives and have to be manually applied.

The model consists of simple glass and emission materials, texture for metal surfaces and textures for lines, numbers and lettering. Overall dimensions of the model: 592 x 522 mm. Blender file is ready to use with all assets packed in (textures etc.).

To make adding a pinch of spice quick and easy, we keep three small Ramikens next to the stove, filled with our most-used seasonings.  We cook a lot, and use them almost everyday; to keep them covered and protected, I made these lids. They’re printed in PLA, and have held up perfectly well for years. Hope you enjoy using them, too.
There are three lids in the set: SALT, PEPPER, and GARLIC; also included is a printing support stand (see below). Small details differ between the caps, because they were designed at different times, using different approaches. Because the ramekins we have are slightly different sizes, so are the covers. And because your ramekins may be different yet, the cover models might need to be scaled to fit. I am able to scale by percentage or specify new sizes in TurboCAD, and can also scale in the UpStudio print manager; your software setup will probably allow the same. The models’ critical dimensions are listed here, along with our ramekin sizes:          RAMEKIN OD    LID ID  LID ODSALT        2.46” 2.48” 2.71”PEPPER  2.65” 2.73” 2.94” GARLIC      2.35” 2.36” 2.52”
ABOUT PRINTING THESE CAPSI want to offer my advice on getting good prints from these models. Printing raised-letter lids with FDM technology presents something of an orientation problem – just how will you position the model for a clean print, requiring the least support removal? Unless you have a powder-bed 3D printer, or a machine which bridges ridiculously, incredibly well, if the lid is placed top up, support will be needed underneath, and if placed top down - which would be fine if the top were flat - the face of the letter will print OK, but there will be a forest of support all around it, and messy removal, either way. Standing the lid on edge also requires supports, and adds the problem of bed adhesion, because of the tiny contact patch. I have an UpBox+ and couldn’t succesfully print in any of these ways, so I’ve been experimenting with printing the caps at an angle, using a support stand I designed for the purpose; that file is included.
The renderings show the stand, separately, and joined with a cap for printing. Detail views show how the stand is minimally attached to the lid: the stand’s upper contact edge tapers to a thin ridge, and the lower contact point just barely contacts the lid’s outside; both attachments can be snipped off clean after printing. This version of the stand worked pretty well, but I’m still developing the design; I included the file as an example and starting point for your versions. For my next version, I plan to change to a 45° angle, and make the lower contact point a tapered edge similar to the upper contact, instead of the dual bumps it is now.

description_text:
A stylish and sleek addition to any bathroom floor in need of cleaning.
Features:
- A collapsible pole via a locking button highlighted by the pop of color in the middle of the mop pole.
- A "no-touch" floor cleaning cloth that sticks to the bottom of the mop head on a rough velcro-like material. A small portion of the cloth is exposed on the sides to ride up on vertical surfaces.  It can be removed by sliding the fluted orange handle down which pushed multiple pins through the bottom of the mop head.  All of the pins push on the cloth at once and separate it from the underside of the mop head.
- A ball-joint pivot point to allow flexibility around the toilet.
- A curvy "speed form" mop head that helps conform to the base of the toilet

description_text:
This is a realistic 3d model of a chair created using blender and rendered using the cycles rendering engine. You can check my profile for other versions. I have only put the blend file but the software is free and amazing.
What You See Is What You Get --->
--> High quality 3d model which can be used in animations & static renders.--> A Subsurf modifier is set on the object and the level can easily be increased or decreased to get a higher or lower quality model.--> A Wireframe modifier, set to not view and not render.--> The scene has realistic lighting; in this case, a sun for the main environment light , and a point light focused near the chair.--> The various components are spread across a few layers.       Layer 1 contains a basic bowl shaped object which gives the illusion of an infinite plane. This object is quite big and the chair can easily be placed inside it. It also contains the lights, i.e., sun & point light.       Layer 2 contains the camera.       Layer 3 contains the main chair object.       Layer 11 contains a basic room and a basic floor. It is very simple but you can expand it further for your renders. I have not included it in any of the presentation images.
*** You can also check out my profile for other models of these and other kind of chairs.****
*** Also note that the model which you get has the subdivision modifier set to view as 1 and render as 2, the final renders which you see above are because the modifier is set to render at 2.
************************************************************************ Poly count when the rendered images are exactly as above. *************************************************************************
Tris --> 61568Vertices --> 30797
************************************************************************ Poly count which you get when you download the file.*******************************************************************************
Tris --> 16448Vertices --> 8233
Note that the difference in renders between the two subsurf settings is not that much but enough to get more realism out of it.

description_text:
This is a 3D photoscan of a goat head I sculpted from clay. If your looking for a stylized and weathered, hand sculpted animal head statue then this is perfect!
Textures: Defuse 4096 x 4096 Normal 4096 x 4096
The tale of the goat head: I first made the model in wet clay, coiling, smearing and carving it. Left it to dry, once dry, it was put in a kiln, heated to 1200 degrees C, and then... BOOOMM!! It exploded, loosing its ears, hence the rugged fractured shapes where the ears should be! Then it was splattered with ochre, dug up from some nearby woodland to colour it. Now it stands in the open, the wind, the rain and sun batter it, even some moss, now growing from the cracks. Something to think about as your prepare the goat head for his next reincarnation.

description_text:
Can opener 3D Model, nr. 1 in my collection. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 18251 vertices, 18112 quad faces (36224 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Glass caraffe with cork top 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
2 Objects (meshes), 2 PBR Materials, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 7332 vertices, 7328 quad faces (14656 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
A single lever Corkscrew 3D Model; 3 objects, parented, so you can easily edit, rotate, rig or animate them (see preview images); a single, non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set for all the three objects. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, and non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons), no poles.
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name. PBR Textures files are included in a subfolder in the BLEND archive, along with scene files.
Made in Blender 3D 2.79 (Cycles materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles for Blender 3D 2.7x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:* nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.79)* nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;* nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;* other images: UV layouts (at least one).
Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.79 with Cycles materials); other: png with Alpha.
3 Objects (meshes), 1 PBR Material (in the Blender Cycles scene), UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter 2.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons), no poles; 21807 vertices, 21741 quad faces (43482 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!* Cycles for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha, normal);* Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);* Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);* Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);* generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)* generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height);so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just drag-and-drop the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!
IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.79 + Cycles using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

-- Spoon (494 polys).-- Knife (514 polys).-- Fork (958 polys).

-- marmoset toolbag scene or built materials.-- high poly models.

description_text:
Kitchen mortar and pestle 3D Models. 2 objects (mortar, pestle), parented, each one with its own non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons), no poles.
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.79 (Cycles materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles for Blender 3D 2.7x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.79)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.79 with Cycles materials); other: png with Alpha.
2 Objects (meshes), 2 PBR Materials, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons), no poles; 8188 vertices, 8184 quad faces (16368 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height);so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.79 + Cycles using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Mincing knife 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons), no poles.
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons), no poles; 16806 vertices, 16800 quad faces (33600 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Plastic honey dipper 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons), no poles.
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons), no poles; 25860 vertices, 25860 quad faces (51720 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
This package includes: The original Blender file with 4 sided polygons instead of triangles, .fbx and .obj exports of each model, textures and the Unity and Unreal Engine folders.
To get the Blender file textures to work correctly, you must go into 'Documents' and create a folder named 'Military Eating Utensils' and then place the Blender file folder and the textures folder inside of it. The Unity and Unreal Engine folders can just be opened and found already set up.
The models are low-poly, but have normals baked from a high-poly version for greater details at less space usage.No Ngons.
These models are based off of South African Military Utensils, so as to avoid confusion, Dixies are the bowl/plate with side swining arms, Pikstel is the collection of the knife, fork and spoon that all slide into one, the Firebucket is the large metal mug and you can boil it's contents while directly over a fire and it is able to hold the 1-litre water bottle as well.
Materials are found in the Blender, Unity and Unreal scenes.
This product includes:
-Dixies (1 Large and 1 Small): 3 seperate parts for ease of animation (Body, left arm and right arm); 1K textures; 4 596 tris; 2 304 verts.
-Firebucket: 3 seperate parts for ease of animation (Body, handle and latch); 1K textures; 3 864 tris; 1 936 verts.
-Pikstel: 3 seperate parts for ease of animation; Knife (140 tris; 72 verts); Spoon (316 tris; 160 verts); Fork (604 tris; 304 verts); 1K textures
-1L Water Bottle: 1K textures; 4 368 tris; 2 188 verts.
Textures: Base_colour, Height, Metallic, Mixed_Ambiant_Occlusion; Normal Open_GL; Roughness. Also textures tailored for and tested in Unity 2019.2.3f1 and Unreal Engine 4.
Hope you like it.Kerj-3D

description_text:
Spoon, small spoon, knife and fork basic cutlery 3D Model. 4 individual objects sharing the same non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
4 Objects (meshes), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 22912 vertices, 22904 quad faces (45808 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
3 Objects (meshes), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 12030 vertices, 12024 quad faces (24048 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

description_text:
This oriental knife set contains four (4) handmade Japanese carbon-steel kitchen knives, using PBR textures created with Substance Painter for metallic workflows. 
Nakiri: Vegetable knife, robust and wider blade. The flat tip makes it more maneuverable.
Santoku: A general use kitchen knife, usually the first step for a new chef buying a good all-around kitchen knife. Good for cutting, chopping and mincing. It was my first kitchen knife, and it has served me well for years. 
Gyuto:  Similiar to the sentoku, but with a longer blade. The tip is sharper making it good for making fine cuts. 
Bunka: Also similiar to the sentoku, used for the same purposes, but with a straight tip. 
I made these as I work as a professional chef, and these knives are my everyday tools. I personally sharpen them every day with a #4000 grit whetstone. A chefs' choice of knife is personal. Some prefer stainless knives, and others prefer carbon-steel knives. These knives use carbon steel, which makes them easier to sharpen, and in my opinion, looks much better than the stainless-steel knives.
This pack contains compressed JPG textures, and lossless PNG textures at 1k, 2k, 4k and 8k.  Base Colour, Height, Roughness, Metallic and Normals are all included. 
I hope you will find a special place for these knives in your renders, games and advertising, just as I've found a special place for them in my kitchen!
About me: 
I am a military chef that has been working with blender, substance painter, Photoshop, and many other softwares for making games, architectural visualizations, and product marketing with various studios, for close to 7 years, I work with a PBR based workflow, while also optimizing my work for games by using clever baking and hand painted textures.  
Nothing is flawless, but that is  what makes the world so exciting! 
**You are free to use any textures, models and maps for any purpose after purchasing them. If you have any questions feel free to contact me!**

description_text:
All preview renders were rendered in Blender 2.8 using Cycles renderer with physically based Principled BSDF shader. Render setup utilizes 16384x8192 HDRI image lighting map (included).Textures are optimized for PBR rendering solutions (using Metalness or Specular workflows).Level 4 subdivision modifier is applied to geometry. Beauty renders uses albedo, roughness and vector displacement maps.
GEOMETRY
Geometry provided is low poly mesh. Mesh is subdividable up to its original sculpt level of 6 to accurately reveal all tiny details of displacement map.Model is designed to provide optimal detail/performance level you need. Not only high detail close-up renders are possible, but lower subdivision level/not subdivided mesh can also be used in game environments.

  - Geometry centered on the origin

  - Real world scale (units: centimeters)

  - Polygonal quads only

  - No poles with more than 5 edges

  - Displacement distance (useful in other software packages):  1.0 cm

  - UVs: linear

TEXTURES
Textures are photorealistic (32 bit per channel EXR) images, created from real object capture data. In order to better preserve visual quality albedo texture is 8192x8192 while all other textures are 4096x4096.Each model UV's were created and inspected according to its specific surface characteristic. This enables to find the optimal balance of maximum texture space allocation, intuitive layout, easy further 2d texture editing possibilities and minimal texture distortion.Textures are designed to fit linear UVs (no internal smoothing, locked UV borders) to avoid UV smoothing errors. Geometry of evenly sized quads guarantees low linear UV texture distortion when subdivided.
Textures used in provided Blender scene:

  - Albedo

  - Roughness

  - Vector Displacement

  - Spherical 16384x8192 HDRI map texture

Additional textures provided in separate archive:

  - Normal (for subdivision level 0 geometry)

  - Specular

  - Glossiness

  - Displacement

No third-party plug-ins used.Scene created in Blender 2.8.
Feel free to leave your feedback. It should help me to better know your needs and actual product reception. My goal is to provide high quality models and constantly improve various aspects of them. Thank you!

description_text:
Scrub sponge 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 6926 vertices, 6924 quad faces (13848 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
- General
This is a realistic model of a generic kitchen chopping board. This cooking accessory was modelled and prepared for photo-realistic renderings, close-ups, CG visualization. The cutting plate model is ready to be inserted in your scene. Give your kitchen visualizations the touch of realism adding this item on the table or on the wall.
  - Meshes
The model is single mesh. The mesh is a mix of quads and polys. The model consists of roughly 12600 polys.
  - Vray Materials
Vray version comes with a properly set materials. You will get 2 versions of vray material: new and used. Other formats have basic materials with texture. So you will have to set up your material specific to your software and render engine.
  - Maps
The kitchen knife cutting board has it’s own set of textures for the new and used look.(4K resolution, 5 textures each including diffuse, glossiness, height, normal and roughness). Beside that, the model is uvw unwrapped. So you can easily apply a different texture map with a name, logo or whatever you desire.
  - Formats
The original file was created in 3ds Max 2014 with V-Ray materials (2.0 and above). You will receive 3DS, FBX, LWO, SKP, 3DM, C4D, OBJ and MAX files(2012 and 2014). 
  - Information
All preview images were rendered with V-Ray. You will get only the Cutting Board with 2 versions of maps for the new and used look of materials. Please also take into consideration that the preview images are the result of the post-production and the look of the chopping board model in your scene may differ due to the specific settings of your own scene. Product is ready to render out-of-the-box. Please note that the lights, cameras, and any background not described above objects are not included in the product. The model is clean and alone in the provided files, centred at the origin and has real-world scale.

description_text:
A Le Creuset Square Skillet and Classic Demi Tea Kettle - a perfect accessory for your dollhouse kitchen project. Easy print and assembly.
This is 3D printable STL file that can be scaled and printed to any size of your liking. The 3D model has been developed using very high quality vector graphics and has excellent resolution. The 3D print job does not require any supports if printed separately and will yield a very high-quality print even at large scales. PLA, ABS, Resin, Powder, Sintered Metal etc. will all work very well for printing this item.

Print on your favourite 3D printer and decorate in the style of your dollhouse. Then leave it over to the young and young at heart to enjoy.
Perfect accessory for a 1:6 Dollhouse (Barbie Size) Other sizes available on request

description_text:
Can opener 3D Model, nr. 2 in my collection. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 9632 vertices, 9622 quad faces (19244 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
A set of 4 ceramic / porcelain decorative empty vases 3D Model. 4 individual objects, each one with its own non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.

Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
4 Objects (meshes), 4 PBR Materials, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 26121 vertices, 26113 quad faces (52226 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Radiator heater 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 5824 vertices, 5688 quad faces (11376 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
2 Objects (meshes), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 3522 vertices, 3500 quad faces (7000 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
School handbell 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 19932 vertices, 19928 quad faces (39856 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Chess clock 3D Model, nr. 1 in my collection. 2 individual objects (clock base, glass), each one with its own non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
2 Objects (meshes), 2 PBR Materials, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 3214 vertices, 3068 quad faces (6136 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Glass candle holder 3D Model. 2 individual objects (glass, candle), each one with its own non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
2 Objects (meshes), 2 PBR Materials, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 1827 vertices, 1786 quad faces (3572 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

description_text:
Two scissors (closed, open) 3D Models, sharing the same non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Each object has 3814 vertices, 3808 quad faces (7616 tris). Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
2 Objects (meshes), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 7628 vertices, 7616 quad faces (15232 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Mugs 3D Model. 3 individual objects sharing the same non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
3 Objects (meshes), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 10139 vertices, 10139 quad faces (20278 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Lantern with candle 3D Model, nr. 3 in my collection. 4 individual objects (handle, frame, candle, glass), sharing two non overlapping UV Layout map, Material (base, glass) and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
4 Objects (meshes), 2 PBR Materials, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 31832 vertices, 31847 quad faces (63694 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

Model of a half-full roll of surgical tape with 2K PBR-textures built to real-world scale (metric system).
