description_text:
Barber brush 3D Model, nr. 1 in my collection. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 48434 vertices, 47432 quad faces (94864 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
A small water tap with a sink and design plumbing. It fits perfectly in a small toilet or bathroom. A high quality model.
The zip contains the 3d models and additional content.
You will get:

  - A high poly textured model (in de SDS folders. 66654 vertices. All parts split into separate files. Scaled to the correct proportions. Available in obj, stl, 3dm, fbx, lwo file format)

  - A low poly mesh (in the Low_obj folder, only unwrapped, not textured, 3648 verticles. All parts split into separate files. Scaled to the correct proportions. Available in obj and fbx file format)

  - A Modo file containing both the high and the low meshes and also containing the particle simulation for the water and the camera track used for the promo video. It also contains a second camera for creating your own renders). If you turn the handle, the particle system gets triggered.

  - A Substance Painter and 3D Coat files that I used for texturing.

  - Textures are 2048x2048, tga and tiff (bigger file format can be requested)

Please contact met for requests.

description_text:
A dog bowl food container 3D Model, nr. 1 in my collection. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, and non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons), no poles.
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name. PBR Textures files are included in a subfolder in the BLEND archive, along with scene files.
Made in Blender 3D 2.79 (Cycles materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles for Blender 3D 2.7x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.79)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.79 with Cycles materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material (in the Blender Cycles scene), UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter 2.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons), no poles; 10670 vertices, 10666 quad faces (21332 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha, normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height);so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just drag-and-drop the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.79 + Cycles using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Glass ashtray 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons), no poles.
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.79 (Cycles materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles for Blender 3D 2.7x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.79)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.79 with Cycles materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons), no poles; 3814 vertices, 3812 quad faces (7624 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height);so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.79 + Cycles using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Increasingly these days more and more things come to you in pouches; petfood, human food, hair colouring, cooking sauces, the list goes on and on.  Although they may be excellent for 'the environment' the one problem they still share with traditional cans and bottles is that there will always be a little bit left in the pouch and in these days when we're encouraged to save as much as we can that little bit of waste can mount up.
Therefore I designed this, the Pouch Squeezer.  It acts roughly like a pair of hair straighteners; you squeeze a little out of the pouch by hand then close the jaws of the squeezer around it, hold onto the bottom of the pouch and slowly drag the squeezer upwards.  This will force the contents of the pouch out and into whatever you're emptying it into, wringing absolutely as much as possible out of the pouch and eliminating that small bit of waste.  It has been tested and works brilliantly on toothpaste tubes, food pouches, hair-product pouches and even paint and oil tubes (although it's not really suitable for aggressive solvents such as acetone, as it will tend to dissolve...)
I actually designed it to be used with catfood pouches; my moggies love catfood in gravy but the last thing I could handle first thing in the morning was cold gravy all over my fingers when I was feeding them.  Therefore I took the designer route and thus the Pouch Squeezer was born!  The open back of the jaws traps any splashing from the catfood which means no gravy'd fingers and it can be easily washed up after use.
The jaws of the Squeezer are 100mm wide, so they obviously can be used with any pouch up to that width.  But if your pouch is wider just squeeze one half and then the other; your fingers will stay clean!
The Pouch Squeezer is available, printed and assembled, in my Etsy store - www.etsy.com/uk/shop/enterprisexddesign

description_text:
An incense stick on a wooden holder 3D Model; 2 objects, each one with its own non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, and non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons), no poles.
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name. PBR Textures files are included in a subfolder in the BLEND archive, along with scene files.
Made in Blender 3D 2.79 (Cycles materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles for Blender 3D 2.7x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.79)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.79 with Cycles materials); other: png with Alpha.
2 Objects (meshes), 2 PBR Materials (in the Blender Cycles scene), UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter 2.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons), no poles; 7076 vertices, 7072 quad faces (14144 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha, normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - Cycles for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height);so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

description_text:
Acoustic megaphone 3D Model, nr. 1 in my collection. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons), no poles.
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.79 (Cycles materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles for Blender 3D 2.7x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.79)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.79 with Cycles materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons), no poles; 13786 vertices, 13784 quad faces (27568 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height);so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.79 + Cycles using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Wrench
A wrench or spanner is a tool used to provide grip and mechanical advantage in applying torque to turn objects—usually rotary fasteners, such as nuts and bolts—or keep them from turning.
In North American English, wrench is the standard term. The most common shapes are called open-end wrench and box-end wrench. In American English, spanner refers to a specialised wrench with a series of pins or tabs around the circumference. (These pins or tabs fit into the holes or notches cut into the object to be turned.) In American commerce, such a wrench may be called a spanner wrench to distinguish it from the British sense of spanner. 
Higher quality wrenches are typically made from chromium-vanadium alloy tool steels and are often drop-forged. They are frequently chrome-plated to resist corrosion and for ease of cleaning.

description_text:
Pick-n-Mix, Cylinder, Standard by Rothschild&Bickers
3d model produced by Place Architecture
ABOUT

  - Created natively in Revit 2019

  - Scaled from manufacturer drawings and photos.

DESCRIPTION

  - This model is a Revit lighting fixture family (.RFA) and is level-based with adjustable heights for the ceiling and cord length.

  - Embedded generic model is fully editable using Revit's built-in geometry tools and is positioned in the center of the family.

  - Includes Autodesk material library with all glass, metal and flex material variations.

  - Includes 3 variations on ceiling rose : Classic, Petite & Empire

  - Includes Phillips IES file for a lamp similar to what is modeled.

  - Includes FBX format, exported from Revit 2019. File units is in millimeters.

NOTE
  - This is a native Revit family, optimised for rendering in Enscape. Not recommended for use with other render / modelling software.
ABOUT THE IMAGERY
  - Previews rendered in Revit using Enscape. Please note that the studio scene and render settings are not included.
SUPPORT
  - If you have any questions about how to use this model, please contact us via Support.

description_text:
Contemporary curtain rod model with antique brass material. 

  - Modeled in 3ds max. 

  - Model is scaled to proper real world dimensions. 

  - Scene units are in cm. 

  - All objects, materials and textures are properly and uniquely named. 

  - All transformations are reset and model is placed at scene origin. 

  - All texture paths are set to relative. 

  - Materials are prepared for Corona renderer. 

  - Textures are collected in one arhive and are delivered in separate file. 

  - Render scene is not included. 

  - Scene has 4 high quality textures up to 1569x1569 resolution. 

  - File formats available: max - fbx - obj - stl 

  - Files other than max, may not have all features available, due to format restrictions. 

  - Some of most common restrictions are: 

  - max scene with scanline renderer - contains simplified materials 

  - fbx - contains simplified materials 

  - obj - contains simplified materials, has no vertex colours s

  - tl - has no materials, has no vertex colours, has no UV coordinates 

***

description_text:
Hallo! Thank you for your interest in my model.You can also check out this model with .STL files designed for 3D printing on my page.

  - There are three LODs of model.

  - LOD-1 12320 vertices / 12362 faces / 24652 tris.

  - LOD-2 197498 vertices / 197504 faces / 395008 tris.

  - LOD-3 3285610 vertices / 3312741 faces / 6571234 tris.

  - Includes four .FBX files (LOD-1, LOD-2, LOD-3, Glass).

  - Includes four .OBJ + .MTL files (LOD-1, LOD-2, LOD-3, Glass).

  - All textures and HDRI are in archive Textures.zip.

  - Includes archived Maya project with Maya scene ready to render in Arnold.

  - Includes Blender scene .BLEND ready to render in Cycles.

  - Materials for glass and cup holder are set up in the Maya scene (Arnold renderer) and Blender scene (Cycles renderer).

  - Also Blender scene contains beer and foam meshes with materials for render.

  - To render in Arnold you have to copy the folders with the textures and HDRI from the archive Textures.zip to the Maya project folder->sourceimages.

  - Also you may need to relink all textures and HDRI paths in Maya and Blender scene.

  - All textures are in the format .TIF (4096x4096).

  - LOD-1 and LOD-2 have UV and the same textures.

  - The model is placed in zero coordinates.

  - Units are centimeters.

  - Original sculpt (LOD-3) retopologyzed by hand to low-poly model (LOD-1).

If you find an error or something goes wrong, please contact me.I will be grateful for your feedback.

description_text:
A set of 5 low-poly pots. Nothing fancy, just meshes with diffuse, roughness and normal maps, as well as displacement maps if you want to turn them into high-poly models. For the latter, the values are already set up in the displacement modifier, just add a multiresolution modifier, move it atop the displacement and subdivide 4 times. The lids and corks on some of the models are separate objects parented to the main models. Centre points of the objects are at the bottom and have been spaced in 0.5 m distances on the y axis. The detail level is around 200-300 vertices per mesh, textures are all 2048x2048.
Included are:
-a rough terracotta jar with a lid
-a glazed, flat vase
-an amphora 
-a green vase with a swirl pattern
-a pot with a wide opening

description_text:
- General
This is a 3d model of Cake Plate and Cloche from Solo Collection by Zwiesel Germany. It was modeled and prepared for photorealistic renderings, close-ups, CG visualization. The cake plate model is ready to be inserted in your scene out of the box.
  - Meshes
The cake plate and cloche models are presented as separate meshes. Total polycount is 27.136.
  - Materials
3Ds Max(corona) version comes with glass material, as visible on the render. Other versions of file have basic material, so you will need to adjust them in connection with your particular software.
  - Maps
No maps are supplied with this model . The 3d model has no uvw mapping.
  - Formats
The original file was created in 3ds Max 2014 with Corona material. You will receive a 3DS, OBJ, LWO, FBX, SKP, C4D, 3DM and MAX file(2014). 
  - Information
All preview images were rendered with Corona. You will get only the Cake Plate and Cloche 3D and not the scenes used for the preview renders. Please also take into consideration that the preview images are the result of the post-production and the look of the 3d model in your scene may differ due to the specific settings of your own scene. Product is ready to render out-of-the-box. Please note that the lights, cameras, and any background not described above objects are not included in the product. The model is clean and alone in the provided files, centred at origin and has real-world scale.

description_text:
High-quality polygonal model. Clean and optimized topology is used for maximum polygon efficiency. Low poly. Ideal for close-ups.
Created in Maya and rendered in Arnold and KeyShot. The Maya file includes an hdr image for specular use and a bump map image. The KeyShot file is the ksp package that includes all textures.
MayaThere are 3 Maya scenes, one is ready with stainless steel material and the 2 others with brass material. One with regular Arnold Shaders and the other with PBR material,The scenes are illuminated by Arnold Skydome Light, with an hdri map, located in the Source Images folder.
In the scene with the stainless steel material the has a polished metal material.
In the scene with the brass material the model has a deccrotaion on the cover, created by a bump map. there are 6 different bump maps to diversify the options for choosing the decoration decoration, each option is displayed here in the preview images.At the bottom of the cover there is a rounded part with a brushed metal look, create by a bump map, located in the source images folder.The scene with the PBR material has no decoration.
KeyShotThe KeyShot project has 8 model sets, one with polished staniless steel material, second with polished brass material, and another 6 model sets of polished material with 6 different decorations  on the cover, one decoration for each model set. These decorations were created by bump maps, located in the Source Images folder. In these 6 model sets there is a rounded part int he bottom of the model with a brushed brass material.This project is iluminated with an hdri file.  Each option of decoration is displayed here in the preview images and in the Rnders folder

description_text:
3D model of Maru pendant light by L&G Studio. Globe size is 10 inches, pendant height is 18 inches.
***MODEL*** Pendant model is made from 6 polygonal objects. All objects are made with subdivision in mind and have Turbosmooth modifier applied. Turbosmooth is instanced for convenient usage. Objects are grouped for easy handling. Model is made of quads and triangles. No N-gons were used. 99% of polygons, are quads. Polycount: Subdivision level - 0 Polys - 3 456 Verts - 3 497 Subdivision level - 2 Polys - 110 336 Verts - 55 345
***MATERIALS*** Materials are prepared for Corona, V-ray and Scanline renderers. Materials originally were authored in 3ds Max for Corona renderer and converted to V-Ray. Due to differences between renderers and possible imperfections in conversion process, V-Ray output might look slightly different than in preview images. Scanline and FBX files has only basic materials and will NOT render the same as in preview images. OBJ file has no materials, but has UVW coordinates intact.
***TEXTURES*** Model has 4 textures of up to 4096 x 4096 resolution. Textures are saved in PNG and JPG formats. Textures are collected in one archive and are delivered in separate file. Unpack textures into the same folder as the model files and 3ds Max should pick up textures automatically.
***SCENE*** Model is scaled to proper real world dimensions. Scene units are in cm. All objects, materials and textures are logically named. All transformations has been reset and model is placed at scene origin [0, 0, 0 XYZ]. All texture paths are set to relative. Objects are separated by materials and named accordingly. All objects in MAX file are logically placed into layers.
***FILE FORMATS*** 3ds Max - Corona 3ds Max - Vray 3ds Max - Scanline FBX OBJ - subdivided OBJ - not subdivided
***GENERAL*** Modeled in 3ds max. Preview images are rendered with Corona renderer. Render scenes are not included.
***

description_text:
Low poly metal tall lamp that was created using Blender.
This model is made up of 3 parts that are joined together to make one object and then textured with different texture maps to make it look more realistic. The entire model uses a diffuse and gloss texture with the gloss texture making the metal look more shiny, and an AO map for calculating shadows. This model can be purchased separately or in the Bedroom Furniture Asset Pack.
About the product:

  - Model is exported in 2 file formats (FBX, OBJ)

  - Textures are in PNG format

  - Textures are 2048x2048

  - Object has been unwrapped and its materials are baked to their UVMaps

  - Object is zipped up into one archive in one folder including its textures

  - All preview images were rendered using the cycles engine and were exported into PNG format

Included Texture Types:

  - Diffuse, AO, Gloss, Roughness

  - UVLayout

description_text:
A kerosene lamp is a type of lighting device that uses kerosene as a fuel. Invented by the Polish pharmacist Ignacy Łukasiewicz in 1853, kerosene lamps have a wick or mantle as light source, protected by a glass chimney or globe; lamps may be used on a table, or hand-held lanterns may be used for portable lighting. Like oil lamps, they are useful for lighting without electricity, such as in regions without rural electrification, in electrified areas during power outages, at campsites, and on boats. There are three types of kerosene lamp: flat-wick, central-draught (tubular round wick), and mantle lamp. Kerosene lanterns meant for portable use have a flat wick and are made in dead-flame, hot-blast, and cold-blast variants.
Suitable for mobile, AR, VR and PC. Works with Unreal Engine 4 and Unity.

description_text:
This is a modular kitchen cabinet section that will act as the main part of a Kitchen scene. This includes many cabinets and drawers with Golden Handles. This model looks very premium and matches most modern kitchen designs. This will be the perfect piece of cabinet to put in your new archviz interior scene of a kitchen. Whether it is modern or the old fashioned kitchen, this cabinet setup has a contemporary design which will match the style of most kitchens. 
The model is well detailed and realistic. It will look nice if you put 2 lights inside the cabinet where there is a hob. This is a low poly model but is realistic.
This model is going to take your new kitchen scene to the next level by adding to the realism as well as with the good topology, this model will bring more realism to your scenes. The model comes with really good topology. Note that the drawers and cabinets are not rigged so if you plan to make animations where you wanna open the drawers, then this might not be the model for you. This is a good model but the inside of the model is not modeled in. Anyway most people will not need that level of detail so this might be enough for most cases. Especially to quickly fill your scene, let's say this covers an entire wall because this cabinet is huge in size. So its easy to fill your scene with elements. You don't have to worry about that side of the wall once you put it in there.
And it is available in multiple formats including FBX, COLLADA, OBJ and STL so you have the flexibility.

  - Unlit shader with outlines.

  - WateringCan_M (Red = Metallic, Green = Roughness, Blue = Color Mask)

  - WateringCan_N (Normal Map)

  - WateringCan_BaseNormal (It's not used by anything, but included in case you want to re-texture and remove the rust)

FOR UE4 ONLY You will find two folders named WateringCan and WateringCan_Optimized. You can simply drag and drop one of those folders into the ../Content folder of your UE4 project and you will get everything ready to use.

  - WateringCan includes the 4k (4096) textures and a Material Instance allowing you to change the Color, Metalness and Roughness of the paint on the can.

  - WateringCan_Optimized only includes the 1024x1024 textures (Dark Blue as seen on the 3rd picture) and no material instance. I recommend you chose this option for the sake of performance and saving disk space.

Of course you can also take the material instance version and put the 1024 textures on it and it'll work just fine.
Both version include LODs (Level of Details) already setup and generated in UE4:

  - LOD0 = 2,318 tris

  - LOD1 = 1,042 tris

  - LOD2 = 115 tris

  - LOD3 =  46 tris

The RichRap Custom Desk Tidy.
This is a set of Six 3D printable Pots to be used as a desk tidy, essential for any 3D print operator, keep your tools handy and print in your choice of colour or add your own textures to make a fully custom full colour version.

Have fun!
Rich - (RichRap)

description_text:
This calibration model is a straw mini bow. Add a standard rubber band and paper straw and you are ready to go.  You can also store the straw on the bow and clip the bow to a backpack or belt. Pictured product was printed at .25mm layer thickness. Infill threshold set to 20cu mm to force infill testing. 30min print time for bow only. The handle is an optional convenience piece is printed separately from the bow body. 
This design serves to test various aspects of your printer calibration.- smooth surface areas- flat areas requiring bridging (handle receptor area) including areas over auto-generated infill (rubber band tie points)- smooth overhanging features (less than 45 degrees) and smoothly sloped surfaces to reveal layer steps along both the x and y axis- horizontal holes to test 3d printer bridging- thin 1mm walls to test gapping between thin walls- setting infill threshold to 20cu mm will force hollow areas w/infill during print and speed up print time.- embossed surface details to test 3D printer resolution- embossed star detail on the bottom of the model will test for any first layer squashing- moving part to test printer clearances (clip) between separating pieces (.2mm)

description_text:
Part of my in-progress Shelf Fillers Series, this file is a collection of photorealistic and physically realistic clayworks, ceramics, and porcelain household objects. Each object is based on a 16 vertex circle. After some testing work I've determined that 16 is the magic number for convincing cylindrical ojects without subsurf trickery. 12 is usually fine, but once in a while I've found the camera gets a flat glaring obviously in the light. In terms of shelves full of low-poly objects, 16 vertex cylinders tend not to break immersion in that way. Of course these models are all subsurf ready, for scenes in which they will be up close. Also for those scenes, every item has a physically real interior as well. This is useful for fluid simulations, scenes taking place in miniature, or even if you feel like breaking them in a scene and having realistic broken pieces.
In this package you will be purchasing the entire .blend file, including ceramic materials I've made in Cycles. I do not have the software to properly test exports in other formats, and thus I can't risk releasing files with errors that I won't be able to detect. You can export the items in any format or configuration that suits your workflow.For legal clarity, the items for sale in this file are the stoneware objects and their materials. The shelf and backdrop textures are externally sourced, CC0, not of my own creation, and thus do not contribute to the sale price.

description_text:
I took a cooking class while in Italy. We used a gnocchi paddle to make gnocchetti. Gnocchetti is a pasta made with flour and water and shaped like potato gnocchi. As a parting gift, we were given a free gnocchi paddle.
After a a few months, my paddle started to crack. I measured it up, drew in Solidworks and printed with wood filled filament on my Prusa 3d printer. The way I oriented the print would have made for a very weak handle. Instead of printing the whole part, I just printed the ridged portion of the paddle and jammed a 3/8" PVC pipe in the end. No glue was required.
I am happy to say that it works great. I have made both gnocchi and gnocchetti with it. 
There are several CAD files available for download: Solidworks, Inventor, Blender, 3dsMax, AutoCAD,  OBJ and STL
Disclaimer: Print and use at your own risk. I have no idea how save the plastic is when it comes in contact with food and there is no way of knowing exactly what comes out of your hot end.

description_text:
After the Meiji Restoration in 1868, the samurai were banned from carrying swords as part of an attempt to modernize Japan. Though a demand for military swords remained and some sword-smiths still produced traditional samurai swords as art, the majority of sword-smiths refocused their skill to cutlery production, following the cultural shift. The production of steel knives in Sakai began in the 16th century, when tobacco was introduced to Japan by the Portuguese and Sakai craftsmen started to make knives for cutting tobacco. The Sakai knife industry received a major boost from the Tokugawa shogunate (1603–1868), which granted Sakai a special seal of approval and enhanced its reputation for quality. Today, Seki, Gifu is considered the home of modern Japanese kitchen cutlery, where state-of-the-art manufacturing technology has updated ancient forging skills to produce a world-class series of stainless and laminated steel kitchen knives.
A high-end traditional japanese kitchen knife pendant in printable and castable STL. format.

description_text:
Collection of the bottles and plates.
Collection includes 21 types of bottles in diffrent shapes, each type of the bottle contains empty glass bottle variant  and 5 variants filled with the difrent types of liquid: blue, red, green glowing, black and white.
Bottles are made of the glass. Bottles are filled almost entirely with liquid, some of them are half-filled
Collection includes additional plates, vases, bowls etc. made of glossy ceramic and glass in diffrent colors.
All elements visible on the renderings are available in the collection, each bottle/element are individual objects so it is easy to pick up the right one.
Each part of the collection has set sub-division modifier so it is possible to choose how much fine resolution of the mesh is needed for your purposes.
Presentation images are rendered with the sub-division set to level 3 using cycles renderer.
Collection has defined simple materials such as transparent glass in diffrent colors, liquids in diffrent colors, glossy ceramics, silver and clay in different colors.
Blender file is divided into 7 scens with set up lighting, main scene contains all elements of the collection, additional scenes contain divided parts of the collection for easier pick up.
Presented numbers of the polygons define whole collection.
